objectives.statement: Recognize and use the neutral pattern with a definite noun followed by a possessive.
Recognize when a possessive before an indefinite noun sounds contrastive or emphatic.
Use egen with possessives to express own, and notice sin without learning the full reflexive system here.
Diagnose and correct common possessive placement errors in short noun phrases.

notes: Must contrast neutral noun-definite + possessive with marked/emphatic possessive + indefinite noun; include egen and avoid stealing full reflexive possessive coverage.
